ok, odd question time:

Set-up: my samedi is in combat with my prey's !malk...it is the second
round of combat, and my previous round's strike was a withering, which
went on the !malk. So, the question is this: can the opposing minion (in
this case, the !malk) play a Reality Mirror and use a Compress that was
in my ash heap as a strike? Does the withering prevent him from using
the card as it requires a discipline to be played? Or does the Reality
Mirror supersede that?

jim

game (or once per combat by a given vampire), Rm wouldn't supercede
that restriction, either.
